summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package declares a preinstall script `node setup.mjs`. On `npm install`, setup.mjs downloads a platform-specific Bun runtime binary from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/..., extracts it, marks it executable, and invokes it via `execFileSync` to run a bundled sibling file `math_init.js`. math_init.js is a ~727 KB `// @bun @bun-cjs` bundle using rotated string-array obfuscation (`function WV8StW(...) {... MmgoCP.push(MmgoCP.shift()); }`) and opaque hex tokens. The package presents itself as a Vue components library, a purpose for which a downloaded alternate runtime is not required. Executing the payload under a freshly-downloaded runtime bypasses Node-based install-time scanning of the executed code. The combination of an alternate-runtime dropper at preinstall time and an obfuscated payload whose file name and content do not correspond to the advertised purpose indicates install-time execution of attacker-controlled code on any machine that installs this package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
